items.title: Why the NFL Kept Its Human Schedulers
items.summary: In episode 1015 of the SuperDataScience podcast, Jon Krohn discusses with Jerry Yurchisin, Decision Intelligence Strategy Manager at Gurobi why the NFL continues to rely on human schedulers despite using advanced optimization software. Jerry explains that while tools like Gurobi enhance efficiency by analyzing thousands of schedules, human expertise remains vital for nuanced decision-making and incorporating real-world factors. This approach ensures that optimization complements, rather than replaces, human roles, making jobs easier and more effective.

items.title: What’s New in Grokking Machine Learning, Second Edition?
items.summary:
Machine learning has changed a lot since the first edition — and so has the way beginners learn it.

In this short, Luis Serrano explains what’s new in Grokking Machine Learning, Second Edition, from refreshed explanations and examples to a clearer path through the fundamentals that still matter in today’s AI and LLM-driven world.

If you want a friendly, intuition-first way to understand machine learning, this edition is built for you.
